items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: there was all with the band. He'd give that up a good while ago, this fellow Izel Robinson.

ctx.x: Was he about your husband's age?

Who, Thomas Copeland? Yeah. I think he might have been a little younger, no. He might have been a little younger, you know. Not too much. I think Izel, you know, we used to call him Ogoose. I think he was about in his age, you know. Maybe he was a little old, I don't know. Maybe just his belt or something, you know. But, uh, there was all, there was all with the band. He'd give that up a good while ago, this fellow Izel Robinson. And he was like, what we call Ogoose, you know. I saw him. Cause he had a, I think…
No, I think he had a restaurant out there. Oh yeah.
